# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 15

**15:1** Then Annas the scribe came to pay Joseph a visit. "Why weren't you at our assembly?" he asked. "I was exhausted from traveling," Joseph said. "I rested up that first day." As Joseph was speaking, Annas caught sight of Mary — and she was visibly pregnant.

**15:2** He bolted straight to the high priest. "Joseph — the man you vouched for — he's done something terrible." The priest asked, "What do you mean?" "The girl he received from the temple," Annas said. "He got her pregnant. He secretly consummated the marriage and told no one."

**15:3** "Are you sure?" the priest asked. "Send some men to check," Annas said. "You'll see." The servants went, found it exactly as Annas had described, and brought Mary and Joseph before the tribunal.

**15:4** The priest looked at Mary. "Why? How could you do this? You were raised in God's own temple — holy ground. An angel fed you with his hands. You heard the angels singing. You danced in the presence of God. And you threw all that away. Why?"

**15:5** Mary could only weep. "I swear before the living God — I am clean. I have never been with a man."

**15:6** The priest turned to Joseph. "And you? What do you have to say?" "I swear before God," Joseph said, "I have done nothing to her." "Don't lie to me," the priest shot back. "You married her in secret. You never reported to the community. You didn't even come forward to have the blessing pronounced over your children. The truth — now."

**15:7** Joseph said nothing.
